data.one_liner: Custom mouse cursors for Flutter that are devicePixelRatio aware.
data.what_it_does: This package provides custom system mouse cursor support for Flutter. It allows creating cursors from asset images, Flutter icons, or raw ui.Image objects. The cursors automatically adjust for the system's devicePixelRatio and when moving between monitors with varying pixel ratios.
use_when: You need custom mouse cursors for desktop or web applications.
Your application handles multiple monitors with different device pixel ratios.
You want to create cursors dynamically from Flutter icons or image assets.
avoid_when: You only need standard built-in system mouse cursors.
You are targeting platform versions where engine support or channels are restricted without required PRs.
strengths: Device pixel ratio aware and handles multi-monitor switching seamlessly.
Trivial to create from images, icons, or ui.Image objects.
weaknesses: Some platform support (like Windows or Web) may require specific Flutter channels or custom engine PRs.
Limited platform targets (macos, linux, windows, web).
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the package and following platform-specific channel notes if using Windows or Web.
